title: Reflexivity is local, or holds where the depth is at least two
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises reflexivity of a finite module over a Noetherian domain by a local condition: at every prime either the localisation is reflexive or the module has depth at least two there. One direction is immediate from localisation of the double dual. For the other, the author forms the double dual as the target of the natural map, records that it is torsion free, and invokes the criterion for a map with depth and associated prime hypotheses: the two cases of the local hypothesis become exactly the two alternatives of that criterion, so the natural map is an isomorphism.
